about: ARENA rules (tools/arena/score.py = tools/web_public/arena/rules.js): XP only from verifiable events, never from $, size, R or trades past the plan.

bot_day.label: Bot ran the market day
bot_day.why: The PC heartbeat was up 90%+ of the 01:30-16:30 ET window (data.json perf.status, Surface heartbeat)

bot_down.label: Bot down most of the day
bot_down.why: Heartbeat up under 50% of the window: no XP, the uptime streak resets

clean_trade.label: Trade inside every rule
clean_trade.why: Stop beyond the sweep, entry 02:00-15:30, flat by 15:55, 1 a day, closed by the bot (data.json accounts)

rule_broken.label: A rule was broken
rule_broken.why: A manual exit, a missing stop, a second trade or a time rule: no XP, the discipline streak resets

plan_week.label: Plan week (2-4 clean trades)
plan_week.why: A finished week with 2-4 Zlarior trades, every one inside the rules; 5+ trades earn nothing

green_week.label: Green week inside the rules
green_week.why: A finished week that closed green with every trade inside the rules (the $ size never counts)

lapse.label: 7-day inactivity lapse
lapse.why: An eval account went 7+ days without a trade: no XP, a warning

eval_passed.label: Eval passed
eval_passed.why: An account's eval status says passed, or it is funded (data.json accounts)

payout.label: Payout
payout.why: A payout recorded on a funded account (data.json accounts funded.payouts); flat XP whatever the amount

task_done.label: Planner task done
task_done.why: A task ticked done in the Planner on this phone (6 a day count)

goal_day.label: Daily goal met
goal_day.why: Every habit checked in, or every task of the day done (Planner on this phone)

habit.label: Habit check-in
habit.why: A habit logged in the Planner (3 a day count)

journal.label: Daily note written
journal.why: A daily note for that date in the Obsidian vault (cached on this phone)

kalshi_day.label: Kalshi bot ran
kalshi_day.why: The Kalshi bot's own feed lists the day (kalshi.json days); its P&L never counts

quest.label: Daily quest
quest.why: Verified on this phone from the quest's own source

quest_sweep.label: All 3 quests
quest_sweep.why: All three of the day's quests verified

boss.label: Weekly boss slain
boss.why: A discipline boss beaten for the finished week (follow the plan, no revenge trade, journal, daily goal), checked on this phone from the week's events; $, size and R never count
